Title: R&D Decision Memory
Cleaned description: A decision layer above experiment trackers that records hypotheses, experiment coverage, failed attempts, parameter choices, evidence and review decisions. It imports runs from MLflow or Weights & Biases, links them to human reasoning, and answers why a choice was made—not only what metric was logged.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Target ML teams with repeated regulated or expensive experiments. Integrate with MLflow/W&B and focus on decision traceability, coverage gaps and failed-experiment reuse rather than building another tracker.
Validation test: Run five workflow interviews and secure two design partners willing to connect a real experiment repository.

Title: Evaluation Dataset Builder for AI Teams
Cleaned description: A workflow for collecting real failures, edge cases and reviewer feedback from AI applications, deduplicating them, assigning taxonomy and ownership, and continuously building versioned evaluation datasets. It connects each release to regressions and unresolved failure families.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Focus on LLM applications with human review queues. Do not begin as a universal annotation platform; own the failure-to-evaluation loop.
Validation test: Obtain two teams' anonymized failure logs and demonstrate a useful regression set within one week.

Title: AI Governance Evidence Builder
Cleaned description: A lightweight governance workspace for small AI product teams that turns policies and regulatory requirements into an actionable evidence checklist. It links each risk to tests, owners, documents and monitoring signals, then produces an audit-ready review pack without claiming to replace lawyers or certification bodies.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start below enterprise governance suites: serve 10–100 person AI companies preparing a customer security review or EU AI Act assessment. Sell one repeatable evidence pack and integrations to GitHub, test results and model cards.
Validation test: Offer a paid manual evidence-readiness review to five AI startups and identify the common repeatable workflow.

Title: Regulatory Change-to-Action Monitor
Cleaned description: A monitoring product that follows a defined set of regulators, contracts and policies, summarizes material changes, maps them to the customer's obligations and creates assigned follow-up tasks with evidence. It is a workflow bridge between alerts and compliance action.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Target one regulation-heavy vertical and one jurisdiction—for example EU AI vendors or French property managers. Curate sources manually before attempting broad crawling.
Validation test: Sell a manually curated weekly change-to-action brief to three companies.

Title: Human-in-the-Loop Agent Control Center
Cleaned description: An operations console for small teams running AI agents. Every agent has a goal, budget, permissions, current state, evidence, pending approvals and rollback plan. Humans can review proposed emails, purchases or configuration changes, intervene when confidence is low and audit what happened afterward.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Do not build another general agent builder. Integrate with existing agent platforms and own the approval, observability and business-control layer for externally consequential actions.
Validation test: Interview 10 teams already running agents and obtain two design partners with a real approval problem.

Title: Specialist Job Search Pipeline
Cleaned description: A high-quality job-search operating system for technical specialists. It learns nuanced preferences, monitors a curated set of employers, scores roles, produces evidence-grounded application drafts, identifies warm referral routes and runs a follow-up CRM. It optimizes expected interview quality rather than application volume.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Narrow to ML/AI engineers in France and Belgium. Begin with company-role discovery, tailored evidence and referral outreach; prohibit automatic submission without review.
Validation test: Run a paid four-week search sprint for five ML engineers and measure interviews per carefully selected application.

Title: Model Data-Gap Scout
Cleaned description: A diagnostic tool that analyzes model errors, coverage, uncertainty and subgroup performance to propose the next data to collect or label. Suggestions are tied to evidence and expected information gain, with a human approving collection priorities.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with one supervised-learning domain and offline datasets. Avoid claiming that an LLM can generically know what data every model needs.
Validation test: Use three public or partner datasets to compare proposed labels against random/uncertainty baselines.

Title: Small-Business Contract & Admin Inbox
Cleaned description: A shared inbox and document vault for small businesses that extracts obligations, renewal dates, amounts owed, missing documents and cancellation windows from contracts, invoices and insurance papers. It turns each item into a traceable task and reminder with a link to the source passage.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Target one underserved profession with repetitive contracts—small landlords, independent consultants or tradespeople. Do not market generic legal advice.
Validation test: Run a manual inbox service for 10 businesses and measure missed-deadline/lookup time saved.

Title: Single-Sport Club OS
Cleaned description: A club operating system for one amateur sport that combines player availability, session creation, equipment assignment, balanced teams, results and optional ELO rankings. Organizers get fewer WhatsApp messages and players get a persistent sporting identity.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with informal volleyball groups in one city. The organizer workflow—attendance, ball/net assignment and balanced teams—is the product; rankings and public discovery come later.
Validation test: Pilot with three recurring volleyball groups for six weeks and measure organizer time saved and weekly retention.

Title: Vertical SaaS Factory
Cleaned description: A product-and-go-to-market factory that maintains reusable modules—authentication, billing, document ingestion, agent workflows, audit logs and analytics—and rapidly assembles narrowly tailored SaaS products for underserved professional niches. The business can operate as a studio that owns products or as a platform used by agencies and venture builders.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Do not expose a generic 'build any SaaS' interface. Pick one reusable workflow, such as document intake and risk review, and launch it in two adjacent regulated niches to prove that the shared core really reduces cost.
Validation test: Choose two adjacent niches, interview 15 users in each and pre-sell one paid pilot before building the shared platform.

Title: Agentic Startup Foundry
Cleaned description: An operating system for turning a raw idea portfolio into one or more evidence-driven businesses. It would rank and compare ideas, research competitors, identify risky assumptions, estimate cost and time, generate an execution roadmap, and maintain a live company workspace. Approved agents could then perform bounded work—research, landing pages, outreach drafts, domain checks and progress updates—while high-impact actions remain behind explicit human approval.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with a decision-and-validation workspace for technical solo founders: portfolio ranking, sourced competitor map, assumption register, landing-page test and weekly execution board. Add agent execution only for reversible tasks after users repeatedly rely on the planning workflow.
Validation test: Recruit 10 technical founders, run their real idea portfolios through a concierge prototype and charge at least 3 for a structured validation sprint.

Title: Club Equipment Library
Cleaned description: A lightweight inventory and lending system for clubs, schools and neighbourhood groups. It tracks who has each item, allocates required equipment to events, handles deposits and reminders, and can open selected inventory to local rental.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start as B2B software for sports clubs and associations with existing shared equipment. Do not begin with a public peer-to-peer marketplace.
Validation test: Pilot with three clubs and measure missing items, organizer messages and return delays.

Title: Living Research Review
Cleaned description: A living-review system for technical books, internal standards and long-lived research documents. It watches cited sources and new literature, flags claims that may need revision, accepts community or expert errata, and produces an editor-approved change history.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Pick one narrow corpus with motivated maintainers—an open technical handbook or medical guideline support document. Do not attempt to update arbitrary books automatically.
Validation test: Partner with one open handbook maintainer and demonstrate useful changes over one month.

Title: Visual Equipment Maintenance Assistant
Cleaned description: A camera-based assistant that identifies the exact appliance, machine or component, retrieves the correct manual and compatible parts, and guides the user through safe maintenance or a technician handoff. The value lies in model-level identification and verified documentation rather than generic visual recognition.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with one category with painful model identification—heat pumps, boilers or commercial kitchen equipment—and serve technicians before consumers.
Validation test: Build a concierge database for one equipment brand and test with five technicians.

Title: Used Asset Deal Intelligence
Cleaned description: A vertical deal-intelligence service that watches second-hand listings, identifies the exact model and configuration, estimates fair value from structured attributes and flags suspicious or unusually attractive offers. It can prepare a concise buyer checklist and first message.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Choose one data-rich category you know—older motorcycles, used EVs or heat pumps—and one geography. Do not start as a universal marketplace scraper.
Validation test: Build a manual weekly deal report for 30 enthusiasts and test paid alerts before automating all sources.

Title: Context-Preserving Localization Workbench
Cleaned description: A localization workbench for illustrated and layout-sensitive content. It detects text regions, keeps character and scene context, proposes translations, reflows the text inside the original layout and records terminology decisions for human editors.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Target small manga/webtoon publishers and fan-translation teams with legitimate rights. Build an editable batch workflow, not a generic browser overlay.
Validation test: Process 10 licensed chapters with two translators and measure editing time saved versus their existing workflow.

Title: Physio Adherence Companion
Cleaned description: A clinician-configured rehabilitation companion that converts a treatment plan into simple rotating sessions, captures completion and discomfort, and shows progress between appointments. Clinics receive adherence summaries; the product does not diagnose or alter treatment without clinician approval.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with one common ankle-rehabilitation protocol used by independent physiotherapists. Software first; postpone custom hardware until adherence demand is proven.
Validation test: Run a six-week pilot with two physios and 20 patients, measuring completion and clinician time.

Title: Creator Archive Factory
Cleaned description: A production system that turns long interviews and archives into a coherent set of assets: searchable transcript, timeline, short videos, podcast episodes, translated versions and a print-ready story. It is sold to institutions and creators with valuable back catalogs.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start as a premium service for one customer type—local museums, retired public figures or family businesses—and productize the repeatable editing pipeline.
Validation test: Sell three fixed-price archive packages and track which production steps repeat.

Title: Outdoor Activity Window Planner
Cleaned description: A planner that answers: where and when within a chosen radius will conditions be best for a specific outdoor activity? It combines weather, daylight, terrain, travel time, facilities and scheduled events into ranked feasible windows.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with motorcycle day trips and outdoor volleyball around Brussels/Paris. Optimize one-day plans rather than building a universal travel app.
Validation test: Publish a weekly concierge recommendation for one activity and convert 20 users to paid alerts.

Title: Amateur Sports Video Analytics
Cleaned description: A phone-camera analytics product for amateur clubs that automatically segments matches, creates player clips and computes a small set of sport-specific metrics. Results feed player development and balanced-team tools without requiring professional tracking hardware.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Pick volleyball and two metrics that are reliable from a fixed phone camera. Forget free-viewpoint 3D initially; deliver useful clips and event detection.
Validation test: Process 20 matches for two clubs and verify whether coaches repeatedly use the clips.

Title: Personal Recency OS
Cleaned description: A personal operations app centered on recency rather than streaks. Users record when important but irregular activities last happened—calling family, changing filters, rehabilitation exercises, administrative renewals—and the system surfaces what is becoming overdue, supports rotating cycles and explains the history in natural language.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Focus on irregular recurring maintenance and care tasks, not daily habits or a full to-do system. The differentiator is 'how long since / when next' with low-friction logging.
Validation test: Launch a mobile prototype to 50 users and measure 8-week retention and weekly completion events.

Title: Offline-First Communication Hub
Cleaned description: A minimal communication layer that aggregates only direct messages, calls, calendar and essential actions from selected services, while hiding feeds, recommendations and engagement mechanics. It can run as a launcher, companion device or managed profile.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start as an Android launcher for one persona—students or focused professionals—and support only notifications plus reply for a small set of messaging apps. Avoid custom hardware.
Validation test: Recruit 50 users for a four-week Android beta and measure screen-time reduction plus retention.

Title: Multilingual Family Story Studio
Cleaned description: A guided service for recording an older relative's life story through conversational interviews. AI creates transcripts, timelines and draft chapters, while editors and family members approve the narrative. The finished package can include a printed book, searchable archive and multilingual audio using consented recordings.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start as a premium done-with-you interview and book service for bilingual European families. Software should support the service before becoming self-serve.
Validation test: Sell five paid story packages before building a self-service platform.

Title: Indoor Retail Route Optimizer
Cleaned description: A retailer SDK that turns a shopping list into an efficient in-store route, updates the path when items are unavailable and surfaces relevant alternatives. Stores maintain product-location data and can embed navigation in their own app or kiosks.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with one independent supermarket or large specialty store using manually maintained aisle data. Prove basket completion and staff-time savings before adding live positioning hardware.
Validation test: Run a pilot in one store and measure route time, failed searches and staff questions.

Title: Portable Technical Skills Passport
Cleaned description: A candidate-owned passport containing verified assessments, structured interview feedback and work-sample evidence that can be selectively shared with employers. Companies define which external assessments they trust, reducing repeated testing while retaining control over hiring standards.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Avoid a universal credential network initially. Start with a consortium of small AI consultancies sharing one standardized practical ML engineering assessment.
Validation test: Secure three employers that agree to honor the same assessment before building a broad platform.

Title: Research Hypothesis Exchange
Cleaned description: A structured platform where researchers publish narrow open problems, proposed experiments and negative results. Peers critique assumptions, attach evidence and earn reputation or sponsor-funded bounties when a proposal is adopted or replicated.
Recommended narrowing / pivot: Start with one technical community and private groups. Avoid claiming ownership or copyright over ideas; focus on traceable contribution and experiment handoff.
Validation test: Run a closed challenge with one lab/community and fund three small experiments.
